name: Music Choice Channel
description: A retro '90s/2000s digital-cable-style audio channel — configure genre "stations" backed by your own music folders, flip between them live like a real Music Choice/DMX channel grid, and tune in to a full-screen now-playing display with a genre-colored background (a gradient, an image slideshow, or a muted looping video).

ipc.why: recursively finds audio files in a station's music folder, and image files in a slideshow background folder
reads the cover image stored inside a track's own tags, to show on screen while it plays, when no cover image sits beside it in the folder
